newsitem.title: USA: Flores & Rucks alters consent solicitation.
newsitem.headline: Flores & Rucks alters consent solicitation.

text.p: Flores & Rucks Inc said on Thursday that it had modified its consent solicitation with respect to its 13-1/2 percent senior notes due 2004.
The company said in a statement that the change arose from discussions with holders of a majority of the total principal amount of the notes.
"The Company is confident that as a result of such modifications and discussions that it has the support of bond holders necessary to execute a Supplemental Indenture," the company said.
"In connection with the modifications, the Company has extended the Expiration Date of the Solicitation until 5:00 p.m. New York City time on Monday, September 16, 1996."
